title: How much water Kestrel Bend Irrigation District should order from the Tolan Valley Project for 2027
subdomain: hydrology-flood-frequency (a season's irrigation requirement at a 24-in-30 non-exceedance level from replayed weather traces through a daily root-zone water balance, at a California irrigation district)
prompt_shape: 13: the thirty weather-year replays with the order at the 24th smallest (the order in whole thousands of acre-feet, the replays chart), and four per-lateral asks on the 2026 season (turnout deliveries, the water put in at the heading, the share of it not delivered, the tail weir spill)
